title: Asghar Haye Asghar
body:
asghar haye asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
haye baysheer mere reh gaya jaake kahan
dashte ghurbat mein kahan dhoondne jaye ye maa
<<DIVIDER>>
aa gayi shaam e sitam hogaye gehre saaye
cha gaya dashte bayaban mein andhera haye
jo guzarti hai mere dil pe karoo kaise bayan
haye baysheer mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
bin tere laal mujhe chain nahi aata hai
yaad aati hai teri dil mera ghabrata hai
godh mein aaja meri mere bete meri jaan
haye baysheer mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
tu mujhe rota hua chod gaya hai jab se
dhoonti phirti hoo mai dashte musibat mein tujhe
koi batlata nahi hai mera chand kahan
haye baysheer mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon barasta kahin laashe pade hai ran mein
khaak par baithi hai shehzadiyan ujde ban mein
koi mazloomo ki ab sunta nahi aah o fughan
haye baysheer mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hai tatheer ke waaris wo huwe khaak basar
jal gaye qaime ridayein bhi nahi hai sar par
dekh to aa ke zara hai qayamat ka samaa
haye baysheer mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
is khadar zulm sahe itne yahan gham paaye
maang bhi ujdi meri godh bhi ujdi haye
haal par mere hui bekasi nauha kuna
haye baysheer mere...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab nahi aaya pisar dashte bala se gohar
khaak par gir padi maa rote huwe ye keh kar
ab kise loriyan de de ke sulayegi ye maa
haye baysheer mere...
author: Gohar Jarchvi
